name: Shadowchains
body:
School conjuration (creation) [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 6, death mage 6, inquisitor 5, paladin 4, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a length of blackened chain)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A creature targeted by this spell is held immobile by dark chains composed of pure shadow. The creature is paralyzed and held in place, but may attempt a new saving throw each round to end the effect. While held by the shadowy chains, a creature cannot use any sort of extradimensional travel, such as astral projection, blink, dimension door, ethereal jaunt, etherealness, gate, maze, plane shift, shadow walk, teleport, and similar spells and spell-like abilities. The spell does not affect creatures that are already in ethereal or astral form when the spell is cast.
